hint.en: Parameter 1: This parameter is used to change the reaction of LED setting.

label.en: Turn on between particular times only (act as night light).

hint.en: Parameter 2: This parameter is used to configure the Night Light on time. User can use Color CC to change the Night Light color(default Red). Only useful when parameter 1 is set to 1.
Parameter 3: This parameter is used to configure the Night Light off time. Only useful when parameter 1 is set to 1.
Parameter 4: Set the duration of blink, unit second.
Parameter 5: Set amount of blinks per second.
Parameter 7: Determines how the action button controls the switch.
Parameter 8: Set the plug’s action in case of power out.
Parameter 30: Determines if alarms are enabled in Switch, and what Switch will react to which alarms.

Parameter 31: Enabled by Alarm Settings, and determines what the switch does in the case an alarm is triggered.
 0 - disable, no reaction to alarm settings
1 - Switch is ON
2 - Switch is OFF
3~255 - Sets rate at which Switch turns ON and OFF in seconds. (i.e. If set to 3, then Switch will turn ON in 0.3 seconds, and then turn OFF in 0.3 seconds in a cycle until user disables the alarm manually. If set to 255, then it will cycle every 25.5 seconds)

Parameter 32: Determines the method of disabling the alarm of the device.
0 - Can be disabled by 1 tapping Switches action button once.
1 - Can be disabled by 2 tapping Switches action button within 1 second.
2 - Can be disabled by 4 tapping Switches action button within 2 seconds.
4 - Can be disabled by pressing and holding Switches action button about 4 seconds.
5~255 - Sets the duration of the alarm in seconds (i.e Sets this setting to 50, the alarm state of the switch will disable after 50 seconds)
Parameter 40: Acts as auto off after as soon as the switch turns ON, setting is set in seconds.
Parameter 41: Acts as auto on after as soon as the switch turns OFF, setting is set in seconds.
